derivation: apparently by erroneous transcription for H6868 (צְרֵדָה);

occurrences.text: And the three hundred blew the trumpets, and the Lord set every man’s sword against his fellow, even throughout all the host: and the host fled to Beth–shittah in Zererath, and to the border of Abel–meholah, unto Tabbath.
